Ivysaur card values: 151 and Base Set are different records

2026-11-05

An Ivysaur card's value depends on the printing, not only the Pokemon name. The English 151 cards 002/165 and 167/165 differ from Base Set 030/102. Within Base Set, an edition and catalog variant can matter even when the number is the same.

Selected English Ivysaur records

These Card AI catalog references were retrieved November 5, 2026:

Set and catalog variantCard numberCatalog finishPublished USD samplePrice date
Scarlet & Violet 151002/165Normal$0.292026-11-05
Scarlet & Violet 151167/165Holofoil$36.462026-11-05
Base Set030/102Normal$4.382026-11-05
Base Set (Shadowless), 1st Edition record030/1021st Edition$86.792026-11-02

The catalog uses the last row's finish field to identify its edition. It is not a label for every shadowless Ivysaur. The table does not enumerate every Base Set edition, language or finish. None of these samples specifies raw condition or slab grade. They are dated published references, not offers, completed-sale records or guaranteed resale values.

Read more than 030/102

For a Base Set copy, check the edition marking, printed layout, language and matching catalog variant. A number alone cannot tell you to use the 1st Edition reference. If you cannot confirm the edition, keep that uncertainty visible instead of choosing the higher-priced result.

For a 151 copy, retain the numerator and denominator. The catalog numbers 002/165 and 167/165 refer to different records with different artwork. Do not use a card's evolution relationship as a reason to borrow a price from Bulbasaur or Venusaur.

Check your own copy in Card AI

Search the app for Ivysaur with its set or full number, or start with the Pokemon card scanner. Review the likely record, confirm the printing, finish and language, and choose the actual raw condition or company and grade on an existing slab.

Then use the card price checker to inspect available price and history. If the matching variant or condition has no price, keep it missing. The website's table is a reference for identifying the record, not a live quote for the physical copy you hold.

For another 151 example, see Charizard 151 card values. Browse Pokemon card value guides for other characters, then keep owned copies distinct in the collection tracker.

Source: Card AI Ivysaur catalog lookup, retrieved November 5, 2026. Only the four selected English records are shown.
